name: The heart watched from afar
summary: Through the Eye, Drakuru says he has watched the search and knows the Heart has been found. He asks for it at Drak’atal Passage, where a brazier will summon his image once more. His promise remains the same: the Keep will be cleansed, his brothers avenged, and its greatest treasure given in return. The words join the two artifacts to the threatened fortress. They also sharpen the question that began in the cage: whose purpose is being served by every promised cleansing?
